name: Dark Hour Menu
author: Sweepercom
credit: Dark Hour Menu template by Sweepercom; inspired by Persona 3 Reload's graphic language
description: A hardcoded character gallery in a midnight-blue, electric-cyan and warning-yellow menu style. Cards are independent Bio markup, so Janitor's card CSS changes cannot break their layout.

components.name: Dark Hour backdrop
components.blurb: The navy field, scanlines, diagonal cuts and menu chrome.

components.name: Profile identity panel
components.blurb: The custom title screen, status readout and navigation rail.

components.name: Hardcoded character cards
components.blurb: Twenty-five independently linked cards with image, title, quote, tags and an animated focus state.

components.name: Menu footer
components.blurb: A compact instruction strip and credit line.

notes: Cards are static markup with live JanitorAI links and hosted avatar images.
The native profile character list can be hidden by the adapter rules in the backdrop component.
Replace card text, links and image URLs in the Bio when your catalogue changes.
